Watch the full episode of S1E1 "No Strings": 

Vision is living in Edinburgh, working at a local bar. Isolated and struggling with his identity and the complexity of human relationships, he retreats to his home in his “Mindspace,” populated by AI personalities including J.A.R.V.I.S., E.D.I.T.H., F.R.I.D.A.Y., DUM-E, U, and Ultron. His peaceful existence is interrupted when a bounty is placed on his head. Meanwhile, a mysterious grifter named Tommy Shepherd is troubled by disturbing memories of Westview.

description:
In this special, hosts Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez sit down with the cast and showrunner of “VisionQuest”: Paul Bettany (Vision), James Spader (Ultron), Ruaridh Mollica (Tommy), and showrunner Terry Matalas. Together they break down the biggest scenes throughout the series, unpack what these events mean for Vision, Ultron, and Tommy, and share behind-the-scenes stories from the set and the writers' room. Expect spoilers, surprises, and discussions of source code, synthezoids, and the search for meaning.
